Same ep’homonymous name:

(Master) Crowley’s: https://thesession.org/tunes/281 is a very different reel, in B minor.

↳ Posted by birlibirdie on May 15th, 2010.

Whenever I hear it, this cheerful wee number immediately conjures up Cathal McConnell live for me! It’s a smashin vision so it is!

↳ Posted by birlibirdie on May 15th, 2010.

News to me….

I’ve never come across “Master” Crowley’s in Bm. Usually E dorian these days, but I first heard Roy Gullane of the “Tannahill Weavers” play it on banjo in the 1970s in D dorian, and that was the common key for it in those days, in the UK, anyway.
As for this particular “Crowley’s”, I recommend the version recorded by Finbar Furey, and also Matt Molloy as a solo on one of the Chieftains records, I seem to remember.

↳ Posted by Kenny on May 16th, 2010.

Tommy Potts plays No281 https://thesession.org/recordings/289 on The Liffey Banks.

And Cathal recorded this one, No759, on the tin whistle, on Long Expectant Comes at Last https://thesession.org/recordings/541 and a spirited take that was!
